_doc: The ten reference cameras (tools/refcams/README.md). eye = TRUE world x,y,z,yaw,pitch (yaw 0 looks north, 90 west; pitch degrees up); agl true = y is metres over the plan's ground there. weather is a Weather.STATE_KEYS name. Change a camera only on purpose: every run before the change stops being comparable for that shot. Wave 5 (refcam2 sessions): one row per new camera, on its own line.
